summary: freeportwest/Romiak_Jusathorn (quests.id 15208): remove the later-era 'trades' / 'second book' dialogue. Before: saying 'trades' or 'second book' summons 51121 Tradeskill Basics : Volume I or 51122 Volume II, neither of which exists in data/items, and the Tattered Note welcome ends with a [trades] prompt. After: a new maintained modified-upstream override without those two event_say branches, without 51121/51122 in the items header, and with the welcome ending at the Shana Liskia sentence, as maintained overrides such as felwitheb/Kinool_Goldsinger do. The hail/chest/find dialogue, the Tattered Note hand-in, its robe, faction and EXP, and the proximity message are unchanged; has_say_event stays 1. Validation: source review, check-proposal, npm test and npm run validate. Not runtime tested.
